About Us

At JAGMA CONSULTING, we believe that technology should empower businesses and individuals. We provide innovative digital solutions for businesses of all sizes, from small businesses to large enterprises. Our team of experienced consultants has a deep understanding of the latest IT trends and technologies.

We are committed to provide our clients with the best possible advice and support, and we collaborate closely with them to ensure that their requirements get fulfilled. We are enthusiastic about delivering high-quality products and services that meet the needs and expectations of our clients.

We are always looking for new challenges and opportunities to gain experience and improve our skills and knowledge. We are proud of our achievements and our reputation in the industry. We are committed to deliver excellence, integrity, and customer satisfaction.

We offer a range of services, such as :

Web design and development : We create stunning and responsive websites that are user-friendly, SEO-optimized, and secure.

Cloud computing : We help our clients migrate to the cloud and leverage the benefits of cloud-based services, such as scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.

Cybersecurity : We protect our clients' data and systems from cyber threats and attacks, using the latest tools and techniques.

Artificial intelligence : We develop smart and innovative solutions that use artificial intelligence, such as chatbots, machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and more.

IT training and support : We help organisation to upskill their existing workforce tailored for the training needs.

About Renuka Shaw

In the dynamic and ever-evolving world of Information Technology, remarkable leaders emerge from diverse backgrounds and unexpected places. One such trailblazer is Renuka Shaw, a woman who defied the odds and rose to prominence from a humble small town upbringing.

Renuka's journey is a testament to the power of determination, resilience, and a deep-seated passion.

Over the years, Renuka honed her skills, worked diligently, and displayed unwavering determination in all her professional endeavors. Her journey wasn't without challenges, but she embraced them as opportunities for growth and learning.

Her remarkable achievements and leadership qualities have not only shattered glass ceilings but also inspired many aspiring IT professionals, especially those from similar small-town backgrounds.

From the challenges she faced to the ground breaking projects she spearheaded, Renuka's story serves as a beacon of hope and motivation for anyone aspiring to break barriers and make their mark in the world of technology.



About Manna Devi

Manna Devi is strategic thinker and a visionary leader and has held leadership positions at several companies. She is founder of an IT consulting company and has multiple developers and young talented engineers deployed on large-scale projects. She works tirelessly with multiple stakeholders at all levels of an organization. She is always looking for new challenges and opportunities to learn and endeavours growth.

Manna Devi is known for strong communication skills, her ability to build relationships, and her problem-solving skills. She is committed to diversity and inclusion and is passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems and make a positive difference to the world.

She has a great belief that the immense talents of her home state can do wonders with if provided a right platform. She wants to contribute for the inclusive overall growth and personal development
